positions.description: Custom-Shop.com designed and built custom skis and snowboards and also offered sales of machinery and raw materials for other ski and snowboard builders and manufacturers.

positions.title: Factory Manager, Hardgoods designer
positions.description: Kuusport is Canada's premiere ski and snowboard accessory company. Kuusport was interested in becoming an OEM snowboard manufacturer and introducing a Kuusport branded snowboard line. I was hired to build and run the factory, and help design the boards. The snowboard division was successful for a couple years until the bottom fell out of the Japanese OEM market in the late 90's (many of their OEM lines were based out of, or on Japanese sales).  With the volume not there to the company's satisfaction the snowboard division was wound down in 1999, though the company remains a top ski and snowboard accessory company in Canada.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: I formed Beyond snowboards in 1995 and built a small factory in Vancouver. Beyond made some of the finest snowboards on the market in the mid 90's, and the company also made a few small brands as an OEM. It was during this period that I started experimenting with modifying large format printers for use in dye sublimation printing for snowboards, as well as custom tooling for one off and short run production that would later become the basis for Custom Shop Snowboards in 1998.

positions.title: Hardgoods Designer, Factory Manager
positions.description: Option was one of the Premiere snowboard companies in the 1990's and 2000's. The owners of Option, interested in breaking into the snowboard market, purchased the Powderstick Snowboards assets (my former company) and hired me to build their factory in Vancouver, design their snowboards and head the marketing effort. Option was essentially Powderstick Snowboards re-branded with additional capital and some new, talented people involved. The company rapidly became very successful and won a Canadian Exporter of the year award in 1996. (The award was won after my departure, although the groundwork I helped lay was instrumental in this achievement).

positions.title: President
positions.description: Powderstick Snowboards was one of the very first snowboard companies in the world, formed in the early 80's. The company was started by myself and pal Greg Whyte (Cirrus Envoronmental currently) while still in High School. The company was quite successful over its 7 year run and was featured in many business and trade publications throughout the world, featuring us as young entrepreneurs making cool products. During these years I developed much of my expertise in snowboard manufacturing and technology, and Powderstick had one of the most advanced snowboard factories in North America at the time.
